author: KEXP
description: French group eat-girls revisit their electronic, post-punk, and folk-influenced sound with a sextet in our latest Live on KEXP session from Trans Musicales.
title: eat-girls performs "3 Omens" & more Live on KEXP from Trans Musicales

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents eat-girls sextet performing live at ESMA in Rennes, France, during Trans Musicales 2025. Recorded December 07, 2025. 

Songs:
earthcore 00:09
3 Omens 04:32
Off The 11:00
On A Crooked Swing 17:40
Unison 25:00
 
Elisa Artero Flores - Guitar, Bass, Vocals
Amélie Guillon - Synths, Vocals
Maxence Mesnier - Violin, Guitar, Bass, Vocals
Lino Lacombe Picos - Drums, Percussions
Reine Murigneux Mitout - Guitar, Bass
Sébastien Perrin - Saxophone, Flute, Guitar

Host: Morgan
Audio & Mastering Engineering: Matt Ogaz
Guest Audio Engineer & Audio Mixing: Maël Birot

Cameras: Jim Beckmann, Carlos Cruz, Scott Holpainen & Luke Knecht
Editor: Scott Holpainen
